Executive coaching

Stay clear when the stakes go up

I coach senior people in tech through the moments where how they communicate matters most: the board meeting, the reorganization, the negotiation, the new role.

What we work on

Bring me what’s on your calendar

A board presentation next month, a conflict with a stakeholder, a decision meeting, a step up into a bigger role. We prepare for it together, and I’ll be honest with you about what’s working.

  • Presence: pace, pauses, emphasis and fewer qualifiers
  • Bottom line first: short updates and clear recommendations
  • Presenting to boards and the C-level, and handling hostile questions
  • Disagreeing without losing authority
  • Panel interviews for Director and VP roles
  • Negotiating senior pay and offers

The first session

Find out where you’re losing ground

In the first session I put you through six realistic situations. Then I score how you did on clarity, conciseness, authority, structure, persuasion, diplomacy, thinking on your feet and cultural awareness.

  1. Introduce yourself in 90 seconds

    Presence, structure and how natural you sound.

  2. Explain a complex project

    Clarity, and adjusting to who’s listening.

  3. Make a recommendation to leadership

    Conciseness and authority.

  4. Disagree with a senior stakeholder

    Diplomacy and confidence.

  5. Answer a question you didn’t expect

    Thinking on your feet and staying calm.

  6. Negotiate a deadline

    Persuasion and managing stakeholders.
